title: India Exports the Naphtha and Benzene Its Own Pharma Industry Needs — Mostly to China

version_history.note: New post: India Exports the Naphtha and Benzene Its Own Pharma Industry Needs -- Mostly to China. Standalone treatment of the naphtha-export finding, extended to benzene (risen 4.5x since FY2022-23) and isobutylbenzene (ibuprofen's own KSM, which is actually declining as exported -- an honest complicating nuance, not force-fit into the same narrative). Built from user-supplied DGCI&S TradeStat bilateral trade data. Also adds a reverse cross-link from the sibling ethanol-freed-up-refinery-capacity-for post.
